label: Long Voyage test: game core, BLE sync, status page
notes: Test build for the bench, not a stable release; nothing updates to it on its own. Runs the game core: the choice log, the story replay, BLE sync between ships and the LV-<ship number> hotspot with a small status page (the phone game is not served by the board yet). Set the ship number in section 4 (each board needs its own), then check it from the REPL with: import selftest; selftest.run(120). Your settings in data/ are kept. To go back, install 0.0.2-coex.
